## Claim correspondence and editorial decisions

- The municipality’s PrishtinArt PDF was directly retrieved and page 159 extracted with pypdf. It supports NEWBORN’s 2008 unveiling and Palace of Youth relationship, plus the library’s domes/metal covering. The institutional library homepage independently confirms “Pjetër Bogdani” naming and Prishtina location. Exterior framing remains; no interior entitlement.

- The heritage database directly confirms Xhamia e Mbretit / Xhamia e Sulltan Mehmet Fatihut II in the old city, near Hamami i Madh and Sahat Kulla. No religious-authenticity or admission claim.

- The gallery’s about page, exhibition index and Gazette Article 3 were directly inspected. They support visual-art institution, international/Kosovo artists and city headquarters. No current exhibition is persisted. The practical note no longer describes itself as a draft in user-facing copy.

- The old airport-line URL returns a sparse dated page; it does not establish present operation. Removed the affirmative service claim. Guidance asks the visitor to confirm operation with Trafiku Urban. Replaced the old 2016–2018 airport incentive PDF with current public provider metadata for PRN identity only.

- Areas remain deliberately empty. The library–NEWBORN–gallery template remains a selection across the stay, not a timed walking route. SQ checked for Prishtinë/Prishtina, library/gallery case endings, mosque name, exterior framing and bus uncertainty.
